verdict.rationale: Docusign's own pages describe several in-product AI features. These include AI-generated agreement summaries and Q&A, AI auto-suggested fields based on agreement type, and AI-Assisted Review that flags risky or non-compliant clauses and suggests redlines and approved language. The IAM platform is also pitched as letting users find, analyze and act on agreements with AI. missing for 10: any independent or hands-on corroboration that these features work as described, in-depth documentation beyond marketing copy, and evidence of portfolio-wide insights across a user's agreement data rather than per-document analysis (some features also sit in separate products such as CLM and AI-Assisted Review).
